::: {#rem-surprisal-log-rarity}
#### Reading the rarity of an outcome

A [density](https://morrison-lab.github.io/pds/random-variables.html#def-pdf) can exceed $1$,
so for a [continuous random variable](https://morrison-lab.github.io/pds/random-variables.html#def-continuous-rv)
the [rarity](#def-rarity) can be below $1$,
and then the [surprisal](#def-surprisal) is negative (@thm-surprisal-log-rarity-continuous).
For a mass, a rarity of $r$ reads "one in $r$",
and the surprisal is the [logarithm](https://morrison-lab.github.io/mds/algebra-exponentials.html#def-logarithm) of $r$ (@thm-surprisal-log-rarity).

:::
